blockers.description: The one additional capture authorization is consumed. The pinned Playwright 1.59.1 runtime still renders light SVG colors in the dark embedded-image probe; the first full catalog also misses the fixed 0.90 cross-engine IoU threshold at 16px DPR1 (0.886). Official Playwright 1.65 now bundles WebKit 27.2, but it has not been tested here and WebKit's SVG image dark-mode issue remains reopened.
blockers.workaround: Preserve both evidence sets. Ask the owner to authorize updating the pinned Playwright runtime to 1.65 and exactly one fresh capture, or to wait/choose another recovery scope. Do not launch browsers or start plan 183-01 before that decision.

human_actions_pending.context: The two authorized capture runs failed. Official Playwright 1.65 now bundles WebKit 27.2, while this project is pinned to 1.59.1. The corrective run tested scheme-specific resource identity, explicit image-level color-scheme, and a pixel-verified theme probe, but WebKit still returned light colors. The new runtime is untested and another browser run requires explicit owner authorization.

decisions.decision: The one corrective capture was used; no further browser run is authorized.
decisions.rationale: The owner authorized exactly one additional capture after the first catalog failed, and that pass also failed its dark-mode probe.

decisions.decision: Keep the approved 0.90 cross-engine IoU threshold and preserve both failed evidence sets.
decisions.rationale: The phase plan forbids lowering the pixel thresholds to accept a failing catalog.
